subject: INTEGER-OF-FORMATTED-DATE function
notes: Neither argument is bracketed, so the admitted count is exactly two and both words are required. Count: the positive writes the two-argument form four ways over one date derived once from §15.48.4 r1 and §15.5.2 (143951 for 1995-02-15) — space- and comma-separated, and in §15.3.1.2's basic and extended calendar formats and §15.3.1.4's basic ordinal format, so what is pinned is the ANALYSIS, not one string — while l1-iofd-arity1 and l1-iofd-arity3 reject one and three (COBOL1504). Required word: l1-iofd-no-function-word omits FUNCTION with no REPOSITORY paragraph (COBOL1543), and l1_repository_bare_intrinsic_names writes the same reference bare under FUNCTION ALL INTRINSIC and requires it to equal its FUNCTION-keyword twin — so KeywordOmittedFunction, cited in this code-location, is reached from both arms.
